senses.gloss: (= b. h. ינה, sec. r. of און, cmp. אָנַן a. b. h. ענה); Pi. (אִנָּה) אִינָּה to press, wrong, oppress; to impose, overreach in dealing, v. אוֹנָאָה.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:12">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>המְאַנֶּה את הגר</he> he who wounds a stranger’s (proselyte’s) feeling.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 49b:14">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>תן לי מה שאִינִּיתָנִי</he> return to me the amount with which thou hast overreached me.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 50a:1">Ib. 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>מה שאניתני</he> (Ms. R. 1 <he>שנִתְאוֹנַנְתִּי</he>, v. infra).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 51a:9">Ib. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>שאניתני</he> (Ms. M. <he>שאֲנַנְתָּנִי</he>, fr. <cite ref="A02252"><he>אָנַן</he></cite>; Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:2">ib. IV, 2</cite> <he>שאוֹנִיתָנִי</he>, v. <cite ref="A00722"><he>אוֹנָאָה</he></cite>, Ms. R. 1 <he>שהוֹנִיתָנִי</he>, v. <cite ref="E00249"><he>הוֹנָאָה</he></cite>, Ms. R. 2 <he>שאונתני</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

senses.gloss: to be overreached. Ib. 49ᵇ מי נ׳ which of them has been overreached? Ib. 50ᵇ מי שנ׳ (Ms. M. מִתְאוֹנֶה); a. fr. [Nithpol. of אנן, נִתְאוֹנֵן, v. supra.] [In. Y. אוֹנָה, v. אוֹנָאָה.]
